reconstruction_notes: Concept side views agree on folded wing and two feet but beak too strongly curved/long: deliberately reduce. Teeth and detailed skeletal anatomy are below this stylized prop scope, not a toothless scientific claim. Tail feather breadth is artistic; no diet or behaviour certainty asserted.

description.en: Delicate olive and cream body standing on two separate feet; long slender tapering snout gently curves downward. Folded layered wings and two narrow long tail feathers. Restrained rust cheek, small dark eyes. Shorten exaggerated ImageGen snout to around head length; no thick duck bill or enormous curlew beak.
